URGENT TRANSPORT · 24 HOURS A DAY · 7 DAYS A WEEK

A part is missing.
Your operations are waiting.
Call us, even at night.

An essential part, materials needed on site or equipment to move: contact us 24/7 to assess your urgent flatbed transport anywhere in Quebec, including very remote regions.

Deliveries to restricted and hard-to-access locations are assessed based on the load, our truck and trailer dimensions, and site conditions. Every departure is confirmed according to availability and feasibility.

02 / YOUR INDUSTRY, OUR DESTINATION

Serving the businesses
that keep Quebec moving.

Commercial transport tailored to your equipment and destination. Photos illustrate the industries we serve.

01 Mining and exploration

Parts, tools and materials for remote sites. We aim to serve mining companies and their suppliers, particularly in Abitibi-Témiscamingue. Site requirements and access are confirmed for each assignment.

02 Steel and metallurgy

Steel suppliers, workshops and industrial businesses: flatbed transport of steel components and products, according to weight, dimensions and handling requirements.

03 Construction

Contractors and site crews: materials, tools and equipment delivered to suit your schedule. Restricted or difficult access is assessed before transport is confirmed.

04 Distribution

A partner for customer deliveries, one-time requirements and recurring routes.

05 Equipment and machinery

Dealers, rental companies, distributors and repair shops: equipment, machinery and parts delivered between your facilities, your customers and their job sites. One-time transport or recurring agreements, based on weight, dimensions and our truck and trailer capacity.

Discuss your recurring needs

06 Energy and telecommunications

Electrical contractors, telecommunications installers and maintenance crews: parts, cables, tools and equipment delivered to your job sites and remote facilities. Scheduled, recurring or urgent assignments, based on the load and access conditions.
